import ast
import json
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt,file_sha256
root=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-batch-probe-v1')
plan_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_batch_probe_plan.json')
plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
source=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_batch_probe/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py')
assert file_sha256(source)==plan['source_sha256']
core=next(n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text())) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='write_text' and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Constant))
assert (root/'dtype_core.py').read_text()==core
runtime=json.loads((root/'runtime.json').read_text());profile=json.loads((root/'batch_profile.json').read_text())
assert runtime['status']==profile['status']=='completed'
assert profile['eligible'] and profile['all_quotes_valid'] and profile['second_repeat_speedup']>=1.5
path=Path('results/training/qwen38_batch_probe_completion.json');assert not path.exists()
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'retain successful training-only batch throughput probe and register distinct inference pair before validation'},runtime['model_revision']),
    'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'eligible_registered_for_validation','plan_sha256':file_sha256(plan_path),
    'wall_seconds':runtime['wall_seconds'],'passes':[{k:v for k,v in p.items() if k!='outputs'} for p in profile['passes']],
    'second_repeat_speedup':profile['second_repeat_speedup'],'all_quotes_valid':True,
    'changed_quotes_serial_to_batch':profile['changed_quotes_serial_to_batch'],'memory_by_gpu':runtime['memory_by_gpu'],
    'decision':'Promote only to fresh validation as a distinct inference policy. Eight agreeing training states do not establish numerical equivalence. Count eleven final candidates before any new validation or held-out aggregate.',
    'downloaded_files':{str(p):{'sha256':file_sha256(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(p.read_text());session=next(s for s in ledger['sessions'] if s['kernel'].endswith('batch-probe') and s['version']==1)
session.update(status=record['status'],hours=runtime['wall_seconds']/3600,script_wall_seconds=runtime['wall_seconds'],script_started_at=runtime['execution_started_at'],script_finished_at=runtime['execution_finished_at'],result_file=str(root/'runtime.json'),hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.')
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/protocol.json');protocol=json.loads(p.read_text());stats=protocol['statistics'] if 'statistics' in protocol else protocol['evaluation']
print('Protocol section',list(stats))
assert stats['final_candidates']==9
stats['final_candidates']=11
stats['family_confidence']='1 - 0.05/(11 * (K + 2)); K is the number of complete API dice cohorts'
stats['newest_family_selection']='Round 3 batch-four promotion: training-only throughput/validity rule passes; register distinct batch-four SFT and GRPO96 on primary seed-zero adapters, validate 100/game on seeds 80000-80099, freeze max min(dice percent -80, cards percent), SFT wins ties, then acquire only the winner on 200/game test seeds 200-399. Both old serial trials and the unselected batch-four adapter count in eleven final candidates. Require ordinary and whole-group corrected positivity. Both local and newest-family choices precede any new held-out aggregate.'
protocol['amendments'].append({'at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reason':'Before batch-four validation or any new held-out aggregate: training-only probe passes the preregistered 1.5x/validity rule (2.764067898942286x). Count distinct batch-four SFT/GRPO pair; preserve both serial trials. No validation or test PnL informs this promotion.','source':str(path),'previous_final_candidates':9,'final_candidates':11})
p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,indent=2)+'\n')
